name: route53globalresolver
description: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver is a global, internet-accessible DNS resolver that enables customers to resolve and forward traffic for both public and private domains while ensuring security and authenticity of queries over the internet.

subcommands.name: associate-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Associates a Route 53 private hosted zone with a Route 53 Global Resolver resource.

subcommands.description: Deletes multiple DNS firewall rules in a single operation.

subcommands.name: batch-update-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Updates multiple DNS firewall rules in a single operation.

subcommands.name: create-access-source
